list: The official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze. 28 hidden. Single player only, no online trophies, no difficulty trophy, one playthrough is enough, about 200 hours, difficulty 4/10.
notes: Cheats disable trophies, and saving is manual (15 slots, no New Game+), so save at the start and end of every chapter. Trophy names and descriptions are the official PlayStation text. Guides are written for this entry in our own words, with the source of each fact named beside the guide.

trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you will earn, and it pops the moment the other 54 are done. There is nothing extra to do for it: work through the roadmap below, keep the checklist ticked, and the platinum lands on its own. Treat it as a progress meter, not a task — when the counter reads 54 of 54, this one follows.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and this pops during the first hour of the game. It is pure story progress, so just play the mission through to its end. Nothing here can be missed, and there is no choice to get wrong.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 in full. Story chapters end on their own as you finish their missions, so keep playing the main mission line and this unlocks at the chapter's close. While you are still in Chapter 1, take the balcony meditation Lucia offers at Jason's house in the morning after Down to Earth — that spot is gone once the chapter ends, with no mission replay to get it back. See Positive Mental Attitude.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Like every chapter trophy, it unlocks automatically when the chapter's final mission ends, so there is nothing to hunt down. Note: some outlets print this chapter's title without the asterisks — the PlayStation list itself shows it as T**s Ass Drug Money, which is the name used here. After Chapter 2, Jason and Lucia can do activities together, which opens the last meditation spot.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Play the main missions until the chapter closes and the trophy pops. One job inside this chapter matters later: Yasmani hands you a Snap Gun for a back-door entry — remember it, because the same quiet approach is what Sneakthief needs.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Finish the chapter's mission line and the trophy unlocks at its end. Two Chapter 4 missions feed other trophies: Child's Play (Family Matters), Headliners (DWNFALL) and VCIA Takedown (Hi-Jacked) each pop as you play them, and an optional mission here opens the bank vaults for Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. This is the gold story trophy, and it pops when the last mission ends. Finish the story first and clean up afterwards — nothing in the finale locks you out of the open world.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 mission. Play it as part of the story and the trophy pops at the mission's end. No special objective is needed — finishing the mission is the whole requirement.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 mission. Finish the heist and the trophy is yours. It is story progress only, so it cannot be missed as long as you play the mission.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play, a Chapter 4 mission. Play through the mission and the trophy unlocks when it ends. It is automatic story progress.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete Headliners, a Chapter 4 mission. Finish the mission and the trophy pops. Nothing extra is required.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 mission. Play the mission to its end and the trophy unlocks. It is pure story progress.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 mission. Finish the mission and the trophy pops. Like all story trophies, it unlocks automatically.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, tracked under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. The checklist is long — about a hundred optional tasks on top of the story, from 39 gang operations and 22 bank jobs to 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 100 flamingos, 30 race wins and 200 discovered vehicles — so treat it as the post-story phase, not something to rush during the story. Work it category by category from the checklist in the roadmap; when the counter hits 100%, this gold trophy pops.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts; the 100% checklist wants 300, out of 397 in the world. Stunts are the jumps, near-misses, airtime and drift moments the game counts as you drive and ride around Leonida, so they pile up naturally if you drive fast and take ramps whenever you see them. If you are short after the story, pick a fast car and chain jumps and drifts on the highways until the counter lands.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The types are the game's side activities — fishing, arcade games, shooting ranges, drone races, street races, bowling, meditation spots and the rest of the leisure menu — so sample one of everything rather than grinding one thing. Open the activity list, tick off a type you have not tried, and move on; a single try of each is enough.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. Each range holds a few timed shooting drills; gold means beating the top score bar, so use a steady weapon, aim for headshots, and repeat a drill until the gold threshold clears. Work range by range — a gold in every challenge is the requirement, not just one gold per range.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations; the 100% checklist wants all 42 races won. Each location hosts a drone course you fly through gates against the clock, so learn the gate line first with a slow run, then push for the win. One win per location is enough for this trophy, but keep going if you are chasing 100%.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 on offer. Any race type counts as long as it is a different event each time, so rotate through the race list instead of replaying your favourite. Pick a fast car or bike you trust, win, and move to the next event on the list.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal issues the challenge by text after a Chapter 1 mission, and the fishing spot shows as a purple icon, so watch for his message and head to the marker. Fishing is a timing mini-game: keep the tension in the safe zone, reel when the fish tires, and out-fish Cal to take the trophy.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet in the world, start any game on it, and play it through to its end. Any cabinet and any game count — one finished run is all it takes.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's mission strand opens in the open world and builds across several jobs; keep taking his missions whenever they appear and the strand ends with a final mission that pops this trophy. Side strands stay open after the story, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through Kenton's strand of missions until its finale and the trophy unlocks. Like the other character strands, it remains available after the story ends.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand is five jobs handed out from the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County, and it opens after a Chapter 2 mission; take the jobs as they appear and the fifth ends the strand. It stays open after the story, so finish it whenever you like.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. The strands that count are Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, plus four more stranger strands — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do NOT count toward this one, even though their own finales have trophies. Take stranger missions whenever their icons appear and keep a note of which strands you have finished; the eighth finale pops the silver.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play Randy's strand to its finale and the trophy unlocks. It stays available after the story, like the other character strands.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's strand of missions and the finale pops this trophy. Note that Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so do it for its own trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida, in 10 locations. Take the Chapter 1 balcony the moment Lucia offers it, then sweep the other spots as the map opens up — meditation prompts appear at scenic points, and each one you sit through counts. The last spot needs Jason and Lucia together, which unlocks after Chapter 2. Do not leave Chapter 1 without the balcony, or the platinum is locked out of that playthrough.
trophies.missableNote: THE ONLY MISSABLE TROPHY. The first spot is the balcony at Jason's house: Lucia invites you to meditate there on a morning after the Down to Earth mission in Chapter 1, and that invitation is gone once Chapter 1 ends — there is no mission replay and no New Game+. The last spot only opens once Jason and Lucia can be together, after Chapter 2. For 100% completion only 15 of the 18 spots are needed, but this trophy wants all 18.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand opens after Chapter 2 and is Jason-only, so take it as Jason and follow Bret's jobs. The exact animal you must hunt has not been confirmed by the big guides yet, so this entry marks the target unconfirmed rather than guessing — check the sources linked here for the latest word before you head out.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.unconfirmedNote: The hunt itself is confirmed; the exact animal you must hunt has not been confirmed by the major guides yet.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets; 100% wants 15 of the 18 sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so pick up every card you pass and check your collection often to see which sets are one card short. Three finished sets pop the silver — keep collecting afterwards if you are chasing 100%.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-world photo app: frame a landmark, curiosity or sculpture and snap it. The 100 break down roughly as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus tagged spots such as No Flusher, so photograph everything the app reacts to as you travel. You will pass most of them naturally if you snap often.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges; 100% wants 70 of the 80. Challenges are the small feats the game tracks across driving, combat, exploration and activities, so they accumulate as you play everything else. Check the challenge list now and then and mop up the easy ones — driving, photography and collection challenges go fastest.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Switch to your partner so you are out together, build the wanted level up to four stars, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. Alleys, tunnels and fast cars help; the trophy pops the moment the heat dies while you are still together.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Go out together, rob one shop, then move straight to the next two while the wanted level stays alive — the chain breaks if the heat dies between robberies. Plan a route with three shops close together and keep a fast getaway car parked nearby.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles; 100% wants 200 of the 277. The game counts a vehicle as discovered when you scan it, so scan every new car, bike, boat and aircraft you see rather than only the ones you drive. Scanning from the start is the cheapest way to build the count, and it feeds the 100% checklist too.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Fill the Focus meter first, then trigger it in a fight with a cluster of enemies and drop five before the meter runs out. An assault rifle and a spot where enemies group up — a gang operation or a shootout — make it far easier than a one-on-one.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport. The trick is to steal a passenger jet at a boarding gate, get it rolling, take off and fly about a kilometre away from the airport. Expect a heavy police response on the runway, so be ready to move the moment you are in the cockpit.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — steal a Rhino tank from the Mile Zero Air Station and put it to use in combat. The base is guarded, so go in fast, grab the tank and start fighting with it; the trophy is about using the tank, not just sitting in it. Bring armour and a quick exit plan for the approach.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: Yasmani gives you a Snap Gun in a Chapter 3 job, and it opens the back door, which is the stealth way in. Slip in, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm — being spotted at any point voids the attempt, so reload a save if it goes loud.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape; there are 8 vaults in total. Vaults open up through an optional Chapter 4 mission, 'That's Where The Money Is…', so do that mission first. Every vault robbery brings a 4-star wanted level, so park a fast bike nearby, plan the escape route before you go in, and do not linger after the cash is grabbed.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around the state; hit one, take the cash and break away from the police. Note that a bank vault job also counts toward this kind of robbery if you escape cleanly, so a vault run can tick both boxes at once.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly a grid over the state and watch the map fill in underneath you. Driving works too, but flying covers the countryside and the islands far quicker, so save this for when you have a plane and an hour to spare.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — one per gang, across all 9 gangs. Gang operations are marked on the map once you find them, so work through the gang list and hit one operation for every gang. The 100% checklist wants 39 operations in total, so keep a note of which gangs you have done.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The description points at a specific seaside spot, but the exact trigger has not been confirmed by the big guides yet — this entry marks it unconfirmed rather than inventing a method. Head to the Ocean Beach waterfront bars and look for the prompt; check the linked sources for the latest confirmed trigger.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.unconfirmedNote: The description points at a specific seaside spot, but the exact trigger has not been confirmed by the major guides yet.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The idea is to drive out through the showroom's glass front, but the exact showroom and trigger have not been confirmed by the big guides yet, so this entry marks it unconfirmed. Do not waste time ramming every dealership until a source confirms the spot.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.unconfirmedNote: The exact showroom and trigger have not been confirmed by the major guides yet.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The bowling alley in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation site: rob the Kingpin Bowling operation there, then shake the police afterwards. It is a hidden trophy, so it will not show its name on PlayStation until you earn it — in this guide it is listed openly, with the spoiler setting hiding it if you prefer.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — raise the Strength of both Jason and Lucia to the maximum. Training together raises both of them at once, so work out with the pair whenever the option appears and keep at it until both hit the top. It is a slow burn, so fold gym sessions into your routine early.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — perform 500 actions that shift your Criminal Profile. The profile moves with the choices you make across missions and free roam, so play normally and vary your approach rather than repeating one behaviour. One warning: do not push the profile all the way to Irredeemable, which is permanent.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something, but no guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet, so this entry marks it unconfirmed rather than guessing. When the community pins it down, the linked sources will be the first place it appears.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.unconfirmedNote: The description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something, but no guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet.

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Something strange is the trigger, but which event counts has not been confirmed by the big guides yet, so this entry marks it unconfirmed. Treat any odd encounter as a candidate, and watch the linked sources for the confirmed method.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.unconfirmedNote: Something strange is the trigger, but which event counts has not been confirmed by the major guides yet.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The name suggests knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, but the exact trigger has not been confirmed by the big guides yet, so this entry marks it unconfirmed rather than stating a method as fact.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.unconfirmedNote: The name suggests knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, but the exact trigger has not been confirmed by the major guides yet.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. The total is cumulative, so every laundered bill counts toward it over the whole playthrough. Yasmani pays the best rates of the contacts, so take marked bills to him when you can and keep laundering whenever the option appears.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every shop in the game, so normal spending on clothes, weapons, food and cars adds up over a playthrough. If you are close after the story, buy a few big-ticket items and the trophy will pop.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 garages, costing roughly $160,000 in total. The four garages the story hands you do not count, so buy the eight listed for sale across the map. They also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you register for On the Spot, so buy them before you start collecting cars.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app comes from Moses in Chapter 2, so pick it up there, then register ten vehicles you own — you need an empty garage slot for each one, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes). Scan, store and register, and the tenth registration pops the trophy.
trophies.name: On the Spot
